name: Folio Notes
note: A keyed note list that reuses rows and moves them with a Web Animations FLIP, search that understands plain words and #tags with highlighted snippets, and a Read mode that renders a small Markdown subset whose checkboxes write back into the source text; pin, move, tag and trash are all undoable. Set --ant-notes-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Tally Tasks
note: A local natural-language parser (dates, times, p1 to p4, #project, @label, "every …") paints what it recognised on a mirror layer behind the quick-add input and previews the result as removable chips; Today, Upcoming, project and label views all derive from one tasks array, completed rows strike through and collapse with WAAPI, and repeating tasks roll forward. Set --ant-tasks-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Kiln Focus Timer
note: A time-stamp based pomodoro (an end time plus one timeout, never decrementing ticks) whose rAF loop only paints and stops off screen or in a hidden tab; the dial is a conic-gradient arc driven by a registered --ant-focus-p, and a registered hue re-colours the whole app as focus turns into a break. The task queue reorders by pointer drag or Alt+arrows with a FLIP settle. Set --ant-focus-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Margin Read-later
note: Reading progress is a scroll-driven animation on the reader's own scroller (a named scroll-timeline lifted with timeline-scope, JS fallback behind @supports), and the same position is saved per article, shown in the list and restored on open. Paragraph highlights sweep in with a background-size transition on box-decoration-break: clone spans, the drop cap uses initial-letter where supported, and the reader pane carries its own size, typeface, measure and page theme. Set --ant-reader-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Daybook Journal
note: Two months of entries come from a seeded PRNG in which each activity nudges the mood, so the 'what lifts you' bars (average with an activity minus without) find a real pattern, recompute the moment today's mood or tags change, and FLIP into their new rank. The selected day's mood colour is a registered <color> @property that eases the entry header between moods; the month is an arrow-key navigable role=grid. Set --ant-journal-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Branch Outliner
note: Bullets are plaintext contenteditable rows over one nested tree: typing only updates the model, while split, indent, outdent, move, merge, complete and fold snapshot for undo and redo, re-render, and FLIP every row (x and y) from where it was. Clicking a bullet zooms in and flies its text into the page title with a Web Animations transform; a filter keeps matching bullets with their ancestors. Set --ant-outline-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Minutes Meeting Notes
note: The notes text is the single source of truth: every keystroke re-reads it line by line into actions ([ ] boxes, TODO:, '@Name to …' with due phrases like 'by Thu'), decisions and open questions, while a mirror layer behind the transparent auto-sized textarea bands each line by kind with a gutter marker. Ticking, reassigning or promoting a question in the side panel rewrites the source line (undoable), hovering an item lights its line, and the recap is generated from the same parse. Set --ant-meeting-h to 100dvh in an app.
html: Minutes

name: Sunday Weekly Review
note: A five-step review over one state object: inbox triage rows collapse out with WAAPI, the look-back chart and totals come from the same week data, stalled projects demand a next action, and the planner takes pointer drags (a velocity-tilted ghost, the target day lights up, capacity bars refill and turn red when a day is overbooked) with a no-drag path of select-then-1-to-5 or 'Move here'. Moves settle with a FLIP and every change is undoable. Set --ant-review-h to 100dvh in an app.
html:
SundayWeekly review · Noor Haddad

    Reviewing 28 Sep – 2 Oct, planning 5 – 9 Oct. Most people take about twenty minutes.
